[=Practical Docs=]

Use this folder for quick reminders and artifact browsing while working in the repo.
These pages should stay short, task-oriented, and light on architectural narration.

[=Read By Task=]

[| [*Page*] | [*Use it for*] |]
[| [<CheatSheet_SPO.wiki|CheatSheet_SPO.wiki>] | current SPO surface-syntax reminders and imperative/pipe examples |]
[| [<CheatSheet_IL.wiki|CheatSheet_IL.wiki>] | current `.ILT` module shape, common commands, and parser-visible extras |]
[| [<Tests.wiki|Tests.wiki>] | browsing real regression sources and their `.result.SPO` oracles by topic |]
[| [<CheatSheet_Wiki.wiki|CheatSheet_Wiki.wiki>] | current wiki syntax, resource blocks, and viewer behavior |]
[| [<TODO.wiki|TODO.wiki>] | short current backlog distilled from the verification pages |]

[=Folder Boundary=]

[| [*If you need*] | [*Open instead*] |]

[| top-level doc-set selection and repo entry points | [<../index.wiki|../index.wiki>] |]

[=Regression Browsing Conventions=]

- [<Tests.wiki|Tests.wiki>] mirrors the executable `.SPO` sources under [.txt|../SPO_CS/Regression.Tests/.]
- it shows `.SPO` inputs together with their `.result.SPO` oracles for quick semantic browsing
- canonical `.ILT` companions stay beside those source files in [.txt|../SPO_CS/Regression.Tests/.] and [.txt|../SPO_CS/Modules/.]
- helper files such as [.txt|_*.SPO.], expected-failure artifacts such as [.txt|*.SPO_Fail.], and generated drift files such as [.txt|*.ILT.new.] are intentionally excluded
- current pass/fail state belongs in [<../doc_ai/40_verification/41_tests_and_artifacts.wiki|41_tests_and_artifacts.wiki>], not in this folder

- move source ownership, runtime semantics, and detailed verification status into [.txt|doc_ai/.]
- prefer linking to the verification pages over copying counts, failures, or dated observations here
